# Read-only diagnosis of a job that was killed by Slurm: list its work files with timestamps, tail its logs, summarize partial outputs.
using JSON3
function tailf(p; n = 2500); s = read(p, String); return s[max(1, end - n + 1):end]; end
function main()
    W = ENV["WORK"]; res = Dict{String,Any}("now" => time(), "host" => gethostname(), "work" => W)
    b = joinpath(W, "bench", "bench-j0"); res["dir_exists"] = isdir(b)
    files = Any[]
    if isdir(b)
        for f in sort(readdir(b))
            p = joinpath(b, f); st = stat(p)
            push!(files, Dict("name" => f, "bytes" => st.size, "mtime" => st.mtime, "isdir" => isdir(p)))
        end
    end
    res["files"] = files
    tails = Dict{String,Any}()
    for f in files
        n = f["name"]
        if startswith(n, "stderr_") || startswith(n, "probe_") && endswith(n, "_stderr.txt"); tails[n] = tailf(joinpath(b, n); n = 1800); end
    end
    res["stderr_tails"] = tails
    outs = Dict{String,Any}()
    for f in files
        n = f["name"]
        if startswith(n, "out_") && endswith(n, ".json")
            try
                d = JSON3.read(read(joinpath(b, n), String), Dict{String,Any})
                recs = d["records"]
                kinds = Dict{String,Int}(); for r in recs; k = string(get(r, "kind", "?")); kinds[k] = get(kinds, k, 0) + 1; end
                outs[n] = Dict("kinds" => kinds, "errors" => [Dict("case" => get(e, "case", nothing), "contender" => get(e, "contender", nothing), "error" => first(string(get(e, "error", "")), 300)) for e in d["errors"]][1:min(end, 12)],
                               "total_seconds" => get(d, "total_seconds", nothing), "env" => get(d, "env", nothing))
            catch e
                outs[n] = Dict("parse_error" => first(sprint(showerror, e), 200))
            end
        end
    end
    res["partial_outputs"] = outs
    logs = Dict{String,Any}(); ld = joinpath(W, "slurm-logs")
    if isdir(ld)
        for f in sort(readdir(ld))
            occursin("2026262", f) || continue
            p = joinpath(ld, f); st = stat(p); logs[f] = Dict("bytes" => st.size, "mtime" => st.mtime, "tail" => tailf(p; n = 3500))
        end
        res["slurm_log_names_recent"] = sort(readdir(ld))[max(1, end - 6):end]
    end
    res["slurm_logs"] = logs
    println(JSON3.write(res))
end
main()
